policy: annotated tag preserved; no wholesale merge/cherry-pick; salvage only concepts still conforming to Q34-Q36 contracts; reject stale/over-scoped/evidence-less/structure-as-mechanism/Q38-Q39 assets

entries.assessment: Candidate data is well-formed and already carries structural_correspondence, surface_similarity, non_correspondence_residue, hidden_premise_transfer, negative_transfer, productive_mismatch and claim_ceiling. The example ana_001 (fixed_point_theory -> change_propagation) is a clean STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY seed usable as a Q37 fixture.
entries.rationale: Concept shape aligns with Q37 spec; data is repo-internal and honest. The file FORMAT (untyped registry) is rejected, not the idea.
entries.canonical_target: data/analogy/analogy-audit-contract.example.json (canonical 5-part shape); ana_001 reused as a fixture seed.

entries.assessment: Residue linkage table; each residue entry references an analogy_id. Concept is exactly the Q37 'known mismatches must not be hidden' rule.
entries.rationale: Directly maps to mapping.known_mismatches + audit 'suspiciously clean' semantic check.

entries.assessment: Untyped placeholder: {registry_type, version, entries} with no enums, no mechanism-evidence/transportability/audit-decision parts, no Q34-Q36 bindings, no exact_head/provenance. Too thin for the canonical contract.
entries.rationale: Does not express the required five-part typed contract; would under-type the audit and allow structure to masquerade as mechanism.

entries.assessment: Toy validator: single pass/fail (exit 0/1), checks presence of domains/residue/hidden-premise/claim-ceiling only. No per-family fail-closed exit codes, no mapping cardinality/directionality, no scale/time/context shift checks, no mechanism-evidence distinction, no transportability assessment, no Q34/Q35/Q33 gates, no exact_head/digest binding.
entries.rationale: Not fail-closed in the sense required by the build campaign; cannot enforce the hard boundaries. Replaced by canonical fail-closed gate mirroring Q36-INT.

entries.assessment: Tests are data-coupled (read the lab candidate file directly) and hard-code a stale origin/main SHA d1bedb07 in test_a4_main_not_modified, which would fail against the current Main. No fixture-driven CLI, no attack matrix.
entries.rationale: Stale main ref and data coupling violate the canonical test discipline; fail-closed attack matrix must be fixture-driven against the real CLI.

entries.assessment: Premises imported from the source domain but unstated in the target mapping — a classic analogy failure mode.
entries.rationale: Directly supports the 'structure must not be upgraded to mechanism' boundary.
